description_en: Modifies the whitelist settings of an ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
description_zh: 调用ModifySecurityIPList接口变更集群白名单设置
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse modify-security-ip-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id cc-xxxxx --group-name test --security-ip-list 192.168.0.0/24,172.16.0.0/24 --modify-mode 0 --api-version 2023-05-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySecurityIPList

parameters.description_en: The name of the whitelist whose settings you want to modify.
parameters.help_en: The name of the whitelist whose settings you want to modify
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.description_en: The IP addresses and CIDR blocks in the whitelist.
parameters.help_en: The IP addresses and CIDR blocks in the whitelist
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.description_en:
The modification mode.

*   0: overwrites the original IP addresses and CIDR blocks in the whitelist.
*   1: adds the IP addresses and CIDR blocks to the whitelist.
*   2: removes the IP addresses and CIDR blocks from the whitelist.

>  We recommend that you set the value to 0.
parameters.description_zh:
修改模式。
- 0：覆盖修改
- 1：增加
- 2：删除

> 建议固定指定0进行覆盖修改
